title: BLOCKED, needs you: AmberX APK signing key + push (fix-apk-signing)
asked: Brett Oct 29 2026: new AmberX APK says 'App not installed'. Fix it so it never happens again; when Claude can't do something, put a wizard in the banner.

steps.text: Diagnose: build 720 is valid (zip, v2 signature, native libs checked on the VPS); builds 717 and 720 have different signing certs, so ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE is not set
Write check-apk.mjs + CI steps (installer checks on AmberX and every catalog APK, expected signer) and commit it: /tmp/axf-apkfix on the VPS
WIZARD 1 (you or Mosses): push the commit in /tmp/axf-apkfix to branch fix/apk-signing (claude.ai has no GitHub login for pushes)
WIZARD 2 (Mosses, root): make ~/.android-keys/axf-debug.keystore (alias androiddebugkey, password android, RSA 2048, ~30 years, mode 600)
WIZARD 3 (Mosses): save it base64-encoded as GitHub secret ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE on MossesX/AmberX-AXF
WIZARD 4 (Mosses): write the cert's SHA-256 (lowercase hex, no colons) to .github/apk-signer.sha256 on fix/apk-signing, push, open the PR, send Brett the merge approval
WIZARD 5: after merge, check the next 'Android framework + console' run passes the new APK install checks; reinstall each app once

doing: Waiting on you: claude.ai is not allowed to push or save GitHub secrets

resume.plan: One stable debug signing key for every CI app build + check-apk.mjs (zip, aapt2 badging, apksigner, zipalign -p, arm64 ABI, expected signer) on the AmberX APK and every catalog APK.
resume.next: Wizard steps 1-5 above. Paste to Mosses: "Do fix-apk-signing: push /tmp/axf-apkfix to fix/apk-signing; make ~/.android-keys/axf-debug.keystore (alias androiddebugkey, password android); save it base64 as secret ANDROID_DEBUG_KEYSTORE on MossesX/AmberX-AXF; write its cert SHA-256 to .github/apk-signer.sha256 on the branch; open the PR and send me the merge approval."
